title.zh: 大师联赛玩家反馈集中修复、DIY 与更新优化
title.en: Master League feedback fixes, DIY and update improvements

items.zh: 修复：大师联赛替补席上有伤停球员时，开赛前自动换成能上场的预备球员，不再出现阵容错乱、无脸门将和“未满 23 人”
items.en: Fix: Master League injured/suspended substitutes are swapped for fit reserves before kick-off; no more scrambled squads, faceless keepers or "fewer than 23"

items.zh: 修复：刷新后从「比赛」页开赛会提示重启，不再弹出选队教程导致闪退；首场教练数值修正
items.en: Fix: after a refresh, starting from the Match page asks for a restart instead of opening the team-pick tutorial and crashing; first-match coach values fixed

items.zh: 优化：大师联赛转会、青训、升格换卡、球衣号码、属性页、外租召回、转播收入与教练周薪等多项改进，新文案支持 10 种语言
items.en: Improved: Master League transfers, youth, card upgrades, shirt numbers, attribute page, loan recall, TV money and manager wages; new texts in 10 languages

items.zh: 修复：旧版导入的 DIY 作品不再被阻断，签约页不再报网络错误
items.en: Fix: DIY works imported from old versions are no longer blocked; the contract page no longer shows a network error

items.zh: 修复：更新时安装被取消、小米提示“缺乏开发者证书”；更新包可选择下载线路
items.en: Fix: cancelled installs and Xiaomi "missing developer certificate"; the update download route can be chosen

items.zh: 修复：更新后资源校验很久并要求重新下载 4.5 GB 资源包的问题
items.en: Fix: after updating, resources were checked for a long time and the 4.5 GB pack was downloaded again

items.zh: 优化：只需下载几 MB 的更新包，游戏资源不用重新下载
items.en: Improved: only a few MB to download; game resources are not downloaded again

title.zh: 大师联赛、DIY 与存储空间优化
title.en: Master League, DIY and storage improvements

items.zh: 优化：大师联赛梦幻选秀抽到“世界级”球员，现在也会播放揭晓动画（以前只有超级巨星以上才有）
items.en: Improved: World Class picks in the Master League dream draft now get the reveal animation (previously only Superstar and above)

items.zh: 修复：欧冠等单场决赛 90 分钟打平，现在会正常进入加时赛；加时仍打平就进入点球大战
items.en: Fix: single-match finals such as the Champions League final now go to extra time when level after 90 minutes, then to penalties

items.zh: 新增：DIY「一键生成全部」，导入大量作品后点一次即可全部生成，只需准备一次资源、重启一次游戏；缺少模型、卡面套装或人物图片的作品会跳过并写明原因
items.en: New: DIY "Generate all" builds every imported project in one go, with one resource preparation and one game restart; projects missing a model, card suite or player image are skipped with the reason shown

items.zh: 修复：永久删除过的 DIY 作品再次导入时，不再提示“相同作品已永久删除”，会自动另存为新作品（卡面、姓名、能力原样保留）
items.en: Fix: re-importing a permanently deleted DIY project no longer fails with "same project permanently deleted"; it is saved as a new project with its card art, name and stats kept

items.zh: 修复：脸模库打开时不再显示为空，读取较慢时会显示“正在读取”并自动重试
items.en: Fix: the face library no longer opens empty; while it loads it shows "Loading" and retries automatically

items.zh: 修复：删除 DIY 教练后游戏里不再留下空白的占位教练，更新后首次启动会自动清理之前留下的；正在阵容中担任主教练的教练需先在游戏里换下才能删除
items.en: Fix: deleting a DIY coach no longer leaves a blank coach in the game, and blank coaches left earlier are removed on the first start after updating; a coach managing a squad must be replaced in the game before deleting

items.zh: 修复：资源文件在手机上被重复保存的问题，更新后可释放约 4 GB 空间；更新失败或中断留下的旧资源现在会自动清理
items.en: Fix: game resources were stored twice on the phone; updating frees about 4 GB, and leftovers of failed or interrupted updates are now cleaned up automatically

items.zh: 优化：只需下载几 MB 的更新包，游戏资源不用重新下载
items.en: Improved: only a few MB to download; game resources are not downloaded again

title.zh: 大师联赛与 DIY 修复

items.zh: 修复：大师联赛外租球员到期归队时，如果原编号已被新球员占用，“继续”会一直提示 action failed、日期无法推进；已经卡住的存档，更新后按一次“继续”即可恢复
items.en: Fix: in Master League, when a player returned from a loan and his number had been given to a new player, "Continue" kept failing with "action failed"; a stuck career recovers on the next "Continue" after updating

items.zh: 修复：导入 V32 导出的 DIY 球员作品后，“检查资源并预览”报错 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cardSuite')、无法生成的问题
items.en: Fix: DIY player projects exported from V32 failed on "Check resources and preview" with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cardSuite')" and could not be generated

items.zh: 修复：以后资源更新时，游戏自己改写过的文件不再被当成损坏，不会再卡在“校验资源”
items.en: Fix: future resource updates no longer treat files the game rewrote as damaged, so they no longer get stuck at "Verifying"

items.zh: 优化：这次更新只需下载几 MB 的更新包，资源不用重新下载
items.en: Improved: this update is only a few MB; resources are not downloaded again

items.zh: 优化：更新改为在线更新模式，避免每次更新 3GB 安装包的繁琐过程
items.en: Improved: updates now work online, so you no longer have to go through a 3 GB installer for every update

items.zh: 新增：保莱塔、努诺·戈麦斯、尤西比奥、波比·查尔顿、博阿滕
items.en: New: Pedro Pauleta, Nuno Gomes, Eusebio, Bobby Charlton and Jerome Boateng

items.zh: 优化：同步官服卡包
items.en: Improved: card packs are now in step with the official server

items.zh: 修复：大师联赛推荐阵容助手的 bug，以及部分赛季无法正常结算的 bug
items.en: Fix: bugs in the Master League recommended-lineup helper, and some seasons that could not be settled properly
